artifact_inspection.note: Robot barista run. The preview has no materials; the refine adds three embedded 2,048 px JPEG textures (base color, metallic-roughness, normal) to the same 61,680-triangle mesh. The rigged file adds one 24-joint skin under a root node scaled 0.01 and stands 1.70 m tall; the rigging task's walk and run files hold 1.07 s and 0.67 s clips. Each animation file holds the whole rigged character again with one clip: Idle 4.03 s, All Night Dance 8.20 s, Big Wave Hello 5.37 s, Victory Cheer 9.37 s and the described move 5.97 s, 13.4 to 13.5 MB each. The Viking's rigged file was 20,407,300 bytes. Model files are not published by this repository.
